RT by @BallsackSports: As I always say, early 2000's is the best era of college football.

Akron vs Marshall 2004. I was 7 years old when my father took my brother and I to the Rubber Bowl to see the Zips come back from down 28-14 with 3 minutes left to win in regulation in an absolute miracle.

It was a really chilly November Friday night. I just remember the drive and walk to the stadium, feeling how brisk it was. College football is so beautiful, and the Rubber Bowl was too. Something about those bright lights and being with the people you love, while watching the sport you love.

Marshall had about 12 chances to effectively end the game and went 0-12. Charlie Frye had a Heisman campaign going, and made routinely made magic out of nothing. 

There was no better feeling than falling in love with college football during the 2000s. The aesthetics, the live atmospheres, the pageantry, music, food, fullbacks, neck rolls… Reggie Bush at USC, Troy Smith, Teddy Ginn and the Vest at Ohio State… Vince Young at Texas… the voice of Keith Jackson

Special, special times around the country
